evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Tube pressure was 2.973 Torr before growth at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen progressively during growth to 3.275 Torr despite essentially constant measured Ar flow; this warrants investigation but does not identify a cause.
Temperature 749.6 °C and Ar 100.1 sccm track setpoints, but O2 remains unavailable, so these readings cannot establish a verified growth atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated exhaust O2 measurement, expected growth pressure range and a pressure/atmosphere diagnostic to distinguish abnormal gas ingress or exhaust restriction from normal behavior; sample characterization is also not yet available.
